basic_info.description: 1622 McAllister is a rare house-like TIC of incredible scale and proportion, measuring almost 3000 square feet. The top floor of a two-unit building for fast-track condo conversion, the home has new, wide plank oak floors, high ceilings and fantastic light. The kitchen has been updated with quartz counters and stainless appliances and has an adjacent massive walkout deck. The garage level is cavernous, with abundant room for parking and storage for both units. The parking is currently tandem but could easily be made side-side by reengineering the center beam supports. Floor plan includes a stately living room, big media or playroom and another bonus room for home office or closet. In a great NOPA location near all the amenities of the Divisadero corridor, this wonderful home is not to be missed.
